title: Permit the pinned sample set in a paired rerun.
comment:
**Permit the pinned sample set in a paired rerun.**

A rerun after a pipeline change cannot pass `sources() === set.sources`. A rerun more than one hour after the draw also cannot pass the age check. Both conditions block the paired 100-verse comparison requested in `llm/releases/STATUS.md` Line 29. Keep the verse IDs and work inputs fixed, but record the new pipeline hashes separately instead of requiring them to match the first run.
